question: Will Jan Paul van Hecke (Tottenham) score at least one goal vs Chelsea on Oct 24, 2026, in regular time + stoppage time only?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Jan Paul van Hecke is officially recorded as having scored at least one goal for Tottenham Hotspur during regular time or stoppage time (excluding extra time and penalty shootouts) of the Premier League match Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge, with kick-off strictly after 2026-10-24T16:30:00Z and the result confirmed at or before 2026-10-25T02:30:00Z.
- "No": Wins if Jan Paul van Hecke is not officially recorded as having scored any goal for Tottenham Hotspur during regular time or stoppage time of the same match, within the same window.

Clarifications:
- Goals scored in extra time or a penalty shootout do not count; only goals attributed to regular time (1'–90') and stoppage time added to either half count.
- Own goals scored by Jan Paul van Hecke (i.e. credited to Chelsea) do not count toward the "Yes" condition.
